title: OpenStudio HVAC Creator Inputs
description: Declarative input for building custom HVAC systems in an OpenStudio model. Components are collected into air loops, plant loops, dedicated outdoor air systems, variable refrigerant flow systems, and zone equipment; system architecture is expressed by the ordering and placement of components. Conventions: (1) Physical quantities are given in either IP or SI units using a suffixed key (for example supply_temp_f or supply_temp_c). Each quantity accepts exactly one IP key and one SI key; if both are supplied they must agree within 0.5 percent after conversion. (2) Objects reference one another by name (loops, zones, schedules, condensing units). A reference may only point to an object defined earlier in the build order. (3) Build order: plant loops (primary then secondary), variable refrigerant flow condensing units, air loops, dedicated outdoor air systems, zone equipment (terminals, then zone equipment, sizing, humidistat, air paths), then cross-loop plant features declared on the loops (waterside economizer, two-pipe changeover, supply water temperature control), then energy management system objects.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the input format this document targets.

custom_system_type.description: Name identifying this custom system type. Recorded on the Building as an additional property.

description.description: Free-text description of the system this input creates. Recorded on the Building as an additional property.

apply_standard_sizing_and_controls.description: When true and this input is applied while creating a typical building, route the result through the standard sizing and efficiency logic (sizing parameters, sizing run, multizone outdoor air sizing, prototype HVAC assumptions, and the efficiency standard). Standards-applied sizes and efficiencies then override any specified here.

plant_loop_info.description: Plant loop definitions. Created first, in listed order, so downstream air and zone equipment may reference them by name.

vrf_info.description: Variable refrigerant flow condensing unit definitions. Referenced by variable refrigerant flow terminals.

ems_info.description: Declarative EnergyManagementSystem definitions. Applied last so programs may reference any HVAC object by name.

availability.description: Availability schedule and optional night-cycle operation for a loop or system.

schedule_name.description: Availability schedule name. The sentinels AlwaysOn and AlwaysOff are resolved to the corresponding constant schedules; any other name must reference an existing schedule.

night_cycle.description: Air-loop night-cycle control. Ignored for plant loops.

fan_operation.description: Fan placement and operating-mode schedule shared by unitary systems, water-to-air heat pumps, variable refrigerant flow terminals, and fan coils.

op_mode_sch_name.description: Fan operating-mode schedule name (continuous vs cycling)

operating_airflows.description: Supply and outdoor airflows by operating mode. Each mode accepts a CFM or m3/s value.

oa_no_load_cfm.description: Outdoor airflow with no cooling or heating load. Default 0.

max_oat_f.description: Maximum outdoor dry-bulb for crankcase heater operation (F)

equipment_list_position.description: Placement of a terminal or zone equipment object within the zone equipment list.

setpoint_range.description: Minimum and maximum setpoint temperature limits.

oat_reset.description: Setpoint reset as a linear function of outdoor air temperature.

setpoint_at_oat_low_f.description: Setpoint at the outdoor low temperature (F)

setpoint_at_oat_high_f.description: Setpoint at the outdoor high temperature (F)

curveRef.description: Performance-curve reference: a named curve (a [source, key] pair into the packaged curve library, or a bare key string), or a user-entered curve object giving the curve type and coefficients directly.

userCurve.description: A performance curve given directly by type and coefficients.

coefficients.description: Coefficients in order (count depends on type)

fanCommon.description: Fields shared by all fan component types. Mixed into the fan hashes; carries no unevaluatedProperties of its own.

motor_airstream_frac.description: Fraction of motor heat entering the airstream (0-1)

pressure_rise_override_inh2o.description: Explicit fan pressure rise (in. H2O) set after a preset fan is built (create_typical_fan ignores its pressure_rise argument for non-exhaust fans)

pressure_rise_override_pa.description: Explicit fan pressure rise (Pa) set after a preset fan is built

dx_rated_performance.description: Rated performance fields shared by single-speed DX cooling and heating coils. Mixed in; carries no unevaluatedProperties of its own.

min_oadb_temp_f.description: Minimum outdoor dry-bulb for compressor operation (F)

water_coil_design.description: Design entering/leaving conditions and flow rates shared by water heating and cooling coils. Mixed in; carries no unevaluatedProperties of its own.

plant_loop_name.description: Name of the plant loop serving the coil

ewt_f.description: Entering water temperature (F). Defaults to the loop design exit temperature.

lwt_f.description: Leaving water temperature (F). Defaults to the entering water temperature minus the loop design temperature difference.

ventilationControl.description: Mechanical ventilation control mapping to the outdoor air and mechanical ventilation controllers.

min_oa_frac_sch_name.description: Minimum outdoor air fraction schedule name

sys_oa_method.description: System outdoor air method for the mechanical ventilation controller

controller_mv_name.description: Name for the mechanical ventilation controller

economizerControl.description: Airside economizer control. Presence of this object configures an economizer.

max_oa_frac_sch_name.description: Maximum outdoor air fraction schedule name

reset_min_db.description: Clear the economizer minimum limit dry-bulb temperature (leave it unset)

oaControl.description: Outdoor air control: mechanical ventilation and airside economizer. Presence of this object (even empty) requests an outdoor air system on the loop.

controller_name.description: Name for the outdoor air controller (defaults to "<loop> OA System Controller").

existing.description: Retrofit mode: apply this entry to an AirLoopHVAC already present in the model, matched by name. No new air loop, outdoor air system, night-cycle manager, or ducts are created. SingleDuct only. A quantity given as null clears (autosizes) the corresponding existing field.

oa_components.description: Components on the outdoor air stream, ordered outboard to mixed air

relief_components.description: Relief/exhaust components, ordered inboard to outboard

return_components.description: Components on the return air branch

supply_components.description: Supply-side components in airflow order, from the mixed-air supply inlet to the supply outlet (discharge to the zones): the first entry is nearest the inlet, the last nearest the discharge. Use the branch key on components for DualDuct.

controls.description: Setpoint managers placed on the supply side

airLoopDesignInfo.description: AirLoopHVAC sizing inputs mapping to SizingSystem.

des_cool_sat_f.description: Central cooling design supply air temperature (F)

des_heat_sat_f.description: Central heating design supply air temperature (F)

all_outdoor_air.description: Size for 100 percent outdoor air rather than a fractional minimum

des_heat_flow_ratio.description: Central heating maximum system air flow ratio (0-1)

use_standard_sizing.description: Apply the standard air-loop SizingSystem defaults (preheat/precool/humidity/design-day airflow methods), taking preheat/precool/cooling/heating supply temperatures from this object.

min_sys_airflow_ratio.description: Minimum system (central heating maximum) air flow ratio used with use_standard_sizing: a number (0-1) pins it, 'autosize' derives it from the zones' heating design flows

central_clg_hr_kgpkg.description: Central cooling design supply air humidity ratio (kg/kg)

central_htg_hr_kgpkg.description: Central heating design supply air humidity ratio (kg/kg)

supply_inlet_components.description: Series components from the loop supply inlet to the supply splitter, in flow order (for example the loop pump).

supply_branches.description: Parallel branches between the supply splitter and mixer. Each inner array is one branch, ordered inlet to outlet; multiple entries in an inner array are placed in series on that branch.

supply_outlet_components.description: Series components from the supply mixer to the loop supply outlet, in flow order.

demand_components.description: Components placed on the demand side of this loop (for example the load side of a fluid-to-fluid heat exchanger). Coils connect to the demand side implicitly by naming this loop, and are not listed here.

demand_inlet_components.description: Series components on the demand inlet, in flow order (for example a variable-speed secondary pump in a primary-secondary common-pipe configuration).

controls.description: Setpoint managers placed on the loop.

supply_bypass_name.description: Name for the supply-equipment bypass pipe (defaults to "<loop> Supply Equipment Bypass").

demand_bypass_name.description: Name for the demand (coil) bypass pipe (defaults to "<loop> Coil Bypass").

ground_hx_loop.description: Treat this loop as a ground heat exchanger loop, driving its temperature-source component from the loop inlet temperature using ems_params.

ems_params.description: Parameters for the ground heat exchanger temperature-source control (used when ground_hx_loop is true).

interconnection.description: How this loop, when it is a secondary_loop, is joined to its primary loop. Required on a secondary loop; ignored on a primary loop.

hx.description: Heat exchanger inputs when type is heat_exchanger

secondary_loop.description: Secondary distribution loop joined to this primary loop per its interconnection object.

waterside_economizer.description: Adds a waterside economizer heat exchanger. Declared on the chilled water loop it serves.

condenser_loop_name.description: Condenser water loop the economizer draws on

integrated.description: true = in series with the chillers (may run simultaneously); false = parallel with the chillers, which are locked out during economizer operation.

supply_water_temperature_control.description: Adds supply water temperature reset control to this loop.

zone_names.description: Zones driving a zone_demand strategy; each must have a thermostat.

two_pipe.description: Converts this hot water loop and its chilled water partner to two-pipe changeover operation. Declared on the hot water loop only.

partner_loop_name.description: Chilled water loop paired with this hot water loop

zone_names.description: Zones driving a zone_demand strategy; each must have a thermostat.

plantLoopDesignInfo.description: Plant loop sizing inputs mapping to SizingPlant.

averaging_window.description: Number of zone timesteps in the coincident sizing averaging window

air_loops.description: Names of AirLoopHVACs served by this dedicated outdoor air system

components.description: Outdoor-air-side components, ordered outboard to mixed air

master_zone_name.description: Zone for the master thermostat location

min_oa_temp_cooling_f.description: Minimum outdoor temperature in cooling mode (F)

min_oa_temp_heating_f.description: Minimum outdoor temperature in heating mode (F)

min_oa_temp_hr_f.description: Minimum outdoor temperature in heat recovery mode (F)

curve_type.description: Performance curve-set key for the condensing unit

air_loop_name.description: Name of the AirLoopHVAC to attach the air terminal to. When set, air_terminal_info is required and its air_terminal_type selects the terminal.

zone_equipment.description: Zone-level HVAC equipment (fan coils, water-to-air heat pumps, variable refrigerant flow terminals, and so on)

load_distribution.description: Zone equipment list load distribution scheme

return_plenum.description: Name of the return plenum ThermalZone

supply_plenum.description: Name of the supply plenum ThermalZone

mixing_source.description: Name of the source ThermalZone for zone mixing

exhaust_from_source.description: Add a dummy exhaust fan in the source zone

airTerminalInfo.description: Terminal inputs. Common fields are top-level; type-specific fields are grouped into the vav, reheat, chilled_beam, piu, and inlet_mixer sub-objects, selected by air_terminal_type. Conditional validation enforces which sub-object each type permits.

air_terminal_type.description: Terminal type. Selects which type-specific sub-object applies.

schedule_name.description: Availability schedule name. Defaults to AlwaysOn.

oa_ctrl.description: Enable outdoor air control on the terminal

min_flow_input_method.description: Zone minimum air flow input method

min_flowfrac_schedule.description: Schedule name driving the minimum air flow fraction

min_turndown_schedule.description: Minimum air flow turndown schedule name

max_flow_per_area_reheat_m2.description: Maximum flow per zone floor area during reheat (m3/s-m2)

reheat.description: Reheat coil and controls for reheat terminals.

coil_surf_area_ft2_per_ft.description: Beam coil surface area per coil length (ft2/ft)

supply_air_flow_cfm.description: Beam supply air volumetric flow rate (CFM)

piu.description: Fields for series and parallel powered induction unit terminals.

min_primary_airflow_cfm.description: Minimum primary air flow (CFM), used to compute the fraction

min_primary_airflow_frac.description: Minimum primary air flow fraction (0-1); takes priority over the min/max flow values

max_secondary_airflow_cfm.description: Maximum secondary (recirculated) air flow (CFM), parallel unit

fan_data.description: Fan overrides for the unit fan

coil_data.description: Reheat coil overrides; defaults to an electric heating coil if omitted

inlet_mixer.description: Fields for the inlet-side mixer terminal.

airStraightComponentTypes.description: StraightComponent air-side types (fans, DX and fuel-fired coils, air-to-air heat exchanger, evaporative cooler, humidifier, HX-assisted cooling coil). Placeable on an air stream and as sub-components inside composites.

waterToAirComponentTypes.description: WaterToAirComponent coils that connect both an air stream and a plant loop.

heatingCoilComponentTypes.description: Heating coils used as terminal reheat or induction-unit coils.

zoneEquipmentTypes.description: ZoneHVACComponent types placeable only as zone equipment.

zoneOrAirLoopEquipmentTypes.description: Equipment placeable either as zone equipment or as an air loop supply component.

airLoopContainerTypes.description: Container types placeable only on an air loop supply node.

plantComponentTypes.description: Types placeable on a plant loop.

airSupplyComponent.description: Component placeable on an air loop supply node: air-stream straight components, water-to-air coils, zone-or-air-loop equipment, and air-loop containers.

airStreamComponent.description: Component placeable on an outdoor air, relief, or return air stream: air-stream straight components and water-to-air coils.

plantComponent.description: Component placeable on a plant loop.

zoneEquipmentComponent.description: Component placeable as zone equipment: zone-only ZoneHVAC equipment and zone-or-air-loop equipment.

subComponent.description: Component placeable inside a composite (unitary system or zone equipment): fans and coils.

heatingCoilComponent.description: A heating coil, for terminal reheat or induction-unit coils.

airSupplyComponentOrSpm.description: An air loop supply component or a setpoint manager.

airStreamComponentOrSpm.description: An air-stream component or a setpoint manager.

obj_type.description: OpenStudio class name of the component. AirSourceHeatPump and CoilSystemCoolingWaterHXAssist are composite pseudo-types that expand into several objects.

schedule_name.description: Availability schedule name. Resolves the AlwaysOn and AlwaysOff sentinels. Defaults to AlwaysOn.

preset.description: Named preset resolved against the packaged data for this component type (for example a fan preset, a DX curve set, or a chiller library entry). Applies preset property values before any explicit values below.

role.description: Sub-component role override within a unitary system: supplemental forces the coil to be the supplemental heater regardless of list position.

branch.description: For DualDuct air loops: which branch to place the component on (Main, OA, or the bypass branch label).

equipment_list_position.description: Placement within the zone equipment list, when this component is zone equipment.

curve_type.description: FanVariableVolume only: fan curve coefficient type

speeds.description: Discrete speeds: array of [flow_fraction, power_fraction] pairs

curve_type.description: Continuous speed control: fan power curve coefficient key

power_bhp.description: Design brake horsepower; used with max_airflow to compute pressure rise

fan_power_w.description: Design electric power consumption (W); takes priority over pressure-rise sizing

econ_lockout.description: Lock out heat recovery during economizer operation

sa_temp_ctrl.description: Enable supply air outlet temperature control

economizer_lockout.description: Lock out heat recovery during economizer operation (delegated-creator form)

defrost_time_increase_rate.description: Rate of defrost time fraction increase

coilDXSSObj.description: CoilCoolingDXSingleSpeed. Default performance curves are supplied by the SDK; cap_ft overrides the total cooling capacity as a function of temperature.

cap_ft.description: Total cooling capacity as a function of temperature curve override

evap_fan_power_w_per_m3s.description: Rated evaporator fan power per volume flow rate (W/(m3/s))

condensate_removal_time_s.description: Nominal time for condensate removal to begin (s)

moisture_evap_ratio.description: Ratio of initial moisture evaporation rate and steady-state latent capacity

crankcase_max_oat_f.description: Maximum outdoor dry-bulb for crankcase heater operation (F)

coilDXVSObj.description: CoilCoolingDXVariableSpeed. Supply either preset (via the component preset key) or an explicit speeds array.

rated_total_capacity_btuh.description: Nominal total cooling capacity (Btu/h); used for capacity_frac scaling

rated_airflow_cfm.description: Nominal air flow rate (CFM); used for flow_frac scaling

nominal_speed_level.description: Speed level at which nominal performance is reported. Defaults to the last speed.

min_oadb_temp_f.description: Minimum outdoor dry-bulb for compressor operation (F)

capacity_frac.description: Fraction of rated_total_capacity. Mutually exclusive with capacity_w.

capacity_w.description: Absolute gross rated capacity (W); takes priority over capacity_frac

flow_frac.description: Fraction of rated_airflow. Mutually exclusive with flow_m3s.

flow_m3s.description: Absolute rated air flow rate (m3/s); takes priority over flow_frac

shr.description: Reference gross rated sensible heat ratio

coilDXMultiSpeedObj.description: CoilCoolingDXMultiSpeed. Stages ordered lowest to highest speed.

stages.description: Per-stage data, lowest to highest speed.

coilHeatDXMultiSpeedObj.description: CoilHeatingDXMultiSpeed. Stages ordered lowest to highest speed.

stages.description: Per-stage data, lowest to highest speed.

coilSysHXAssistObj.description: CoilSystemCoolingWaterHXAssist wraps a CoilCoolingWater inside an air-to-air heat exchanger.

plf_curve_coeffs.description: Part-load fraction correlation cubic curve coefficients

min_oadb_compressor_f.description: Minimum outdoor dry-bulb for compressor operation (F)

max_oadb_defrost_f.description: Maximum outdoor dry-bulb for defrost operation (F)

reset_defrost_time.description: Reset the defrost time period fraction to its default

components.description: Sub-components: fan, cooling coil, heating coil, supplemental coil

supplemental_max_oat_f.description: Maximum outdoor dry-bulb temperature for supplemental heater operation (F)

cu_name.description: Name of the variable refrigerant flow condensing unit

op_mode_sch_name.description: Supply air fan operating mode schedule name

no_ventilation.description: Zero the outdoor air flow rates

fan.description: Overrides for the terminal's built-in supply fan (name, pressure rise, efficiencies)

max_elec_w.description: Maximum electrical power to the panel (W)

fpfcObj.description: ZoneHVACFourPipeFanCoil. With components, the fan and coils are built from the sub-hashes; without them, typical sub-components are synthesized from the loop names.

chilled_water_loop_name.description: Chilled water loop for a synthesized cooling coil

hot_water_loop_name.description: Hot water loop for a synthesized heating coil; electric heat when absent

htg_coil_lat_f.description: Synthesized heating coil rated leaving air temperature (F)

ventilation.description: Include outdoor air ventilation on the unit

no_ventilation.description: Zero the maximum outdoor air flow rate (ventilation supplied by a separate system)

uhObj.description: ZoneHVACUnitHeater. With components, the fan and coil are built from the sub-hashes; without them, typical sub-components are synthesized from heating_type.

hot_water_loop_name.description: Hot water loop for a synthesized water heating coil

zoneWAHPObj.description: ZoneHVACWaterToAirHeatPump. With components, the coils and fan are built from the sub-hashes; without them, typical sub-components are synthesized from the condenser loop.

components.description: Cooling coil, heating coil, fan, and optional supplemental coil

condenser_loop_name.description: Condenser loop for synthesized water-to-air heat pump coils

ventilation.description: Include outdoor air ventilation on the unit

no_ventilation.description: Zero the outdoor air flow rates (ventilation supplied by a separate system)

ptacObj.description: ZoneHVACPackagedTerminalAirConditioner. Sub-components are either an explicit components list or synthesized from the type selections.

components.description: Explicit sub-components: fan, cooling coil, heating coil

hot_water_loop_name.description: Hot water loop when heating_type is Water

op_mode_sch_name.description: Supply air fan operating mode schedule name

no_ventilation.description: Zero the outdoor air flow rates (ventilation supplied by a separate system)

ventilation.description: Include outdoor air ventilation on the unit

pthpObj.description: ZoneHVACPackagedTerminalHeatPump. Sub-components are either an explicit components list or synthesized.

components.description: Explicit sub-components: fan, cooling coil, heating coil, supplemental heating coil

op_mode_sch_name.description: Supply air fan operating mode schedule name

no_ventilation.description: Zero the outdoor air flow rates (ventilation supplied by a separate system)

ventilation.description: Include outdoor air ventilation on the unit

baseboardWaterObj.description: ZoneHVACBaseboardConvectiveWater with a hot water baseboard coil.

coil_name.description: Name for the hot water baseboard heating coil

radiant_fraction.description: Fraction of input converted to radiant energy (0-1)

lowTempRadiantObj.description: ZoneHVACLowTempRadiantVarFlow: slab internal-source constructions, control schedules, and control-strategy logic. Two-pipe changeover and plant supply water temperature control are declared on the plant loop entries, not here.

control_zone_names.description: All zones in the radiant group, used by zone-demand control strategies

slab_setpoint_reset.description: Slab setpoint reset as a function of outdoor air temperature

zoneErvObj.description: ZoneHVACEnergyRecoveryVentilator with supply and exhaust fans and a heat exchanger.

erv_preset.description: Preset fan and heat exchanger configuration

high_humidity_control.description: Control high indoor humidity based on outdoor humidity ratio

vent_per_area_m3s_m2.description: Ventilation rate per unit floor area (m3/s-m2)

flow_rate.description: Flow rate: per zone floor area (m3/s-m2) for Exhaust and Intake, absolute (m3/s) for Natural

water_pump_power_sizing_factor.description: Recirculating water pump power sizing factor (W-s/m3)

autosize_primary_air.description: Autosize the primary air design flow rate

autosize_water_pump.description: Autosize the recirculating water pump power consumption

humidifierSteamObj.description: HumidifierSteamElectric. Capacity and power autosize when not given.

vsd_control_type.description: Selects part-load ratio curve coefficients when plr_coeffs is absent

frac_motor_to_fluid.description: Fraction of motor inefficiencies to the fluid stream (0-1)

num_pumps.description: Number of pumps in the bank

type.description: When Condensing, the efficiency curve uses the entering boiler temperature.

ashpObj.description: AirSourceHeatPump, a plant-loop heating source with a coefficient of performance. Placed on the loop named by plant_loop_name, or on the enclosing plant loop when absent.

plant_loop_name.description: Loop to place the heat pump on. Defaults to the enclosing plant loop.

chillerEIRObj.description: ChillerElectricEIR. Placed on the chilled water loop supply. When condenser_type is WaterCooled, condenser_loop_name names the condenser loop the chiller rejects heat to (that loop must be defined earlier in the spec).

condenser_type.description: Defaults to WaterCooled when condenser_loop_name is given, otherwise AirCooled.

condenser_loop_name.description: Condenser loop the chiller rejects heat to (WaterCooled)

leaving_chw_lower_limit_f.description: Leaving chilled water lower temperature limit (F)

plantTempSourceObj.description: PlantComponentTemperatureSource, a constant or scheduled temperature source (for example mimicking a ground heat exchanger). On a plant loop with ground_hx_loop true, its source schedule is driven from the loop inlet temperature using the loop ems_params.

source_temp_schedule_name.description: Source temperature schedule name (created as a constant schedule if missing)

design_oa_name.description: Design specification outdoor air object name to reference

cool_sensible_heat_ratio.description: Cooling sensible heat ratio (with ConstantSensibleHeatRatio dehumidification)

include_outdoor_air.description: Use the zone design specification outdoor air object

setpointManager.description: Setpoint manager definition used in air loop controls, plant loop controls, and inline with air and outdoor air component lists.

spm_node.description: Placement override. Supply = supply outlet node; Mixed = mixed air node; any other string is matched first against a component name on the loop, then against a component IDD type, and the manager is placed at that component's outlet. When omitted, the manager is placed at its natural default node (mixed air node for MixedAir, supply outlet otherwise).

spm_sch_name.description: Existing schedule name for scheduled managers; takes precedence over constant setpoints.

spmScheduledObj.description: SetpointManagerScheduled. Requires exactly one of spm_temp or spm_hr.

spm_temp_f.description: Constant temperature setpoint (F). Creates a temperature control variable.

ctrl_var.description: Control variable for humidity ratio setpoints. Defaults to MaximumHumidityRatio.

spm_lo_sch_name.description: Low setpoint schedule name (used instead of spm_lo_temp to reference a shared schedule)

spm_hi_sch_name.description: High setpoint schedule name (used instead of spm_hi_temp to reference a shared schedule)

spmSZHumMinObj.description: SetpointManagerSingleZoneHumidityMinimum, typically placed at a humidifier outlet via the spm_node override.

reference_node.description: Name of the reference node, or Supply to use the supply outlet node

spmOAPretreatObj.description: SetpointManagerOutdoorAirPretreat. The reference, mixed air, outdoor air, and return air nodes are set from the enclosing dedicated outdoor air or outdoor air component list.

zoneSizing.description: Zone sizing inputs mapping to SizingZone.

clg_dsgn_sup_air_temp_f.description: Zone cooling design supply air temperature (F)

htg_dsgn_sup_air_temp_f.description: Zone heating design supply air temperature (F)

clg_dsgn_sup_air_humidity_ratio_kgpkg.description: Zone cooling design supply air humidity ratio (kg/kg)

htg_dsgn_sup_air_humidity_ratio_kgpkg.description: Zone heating design supply air humidity ratio (kg/kg)

account_for_doas.description: Account for a dedicated outdoor air system

doas_low_setpoint_f.description: Dedicated outdoor air system low design setpoint (F)

doas_high_setpoint_f.description: Dedicated outdoor air system high design setpoint (F)

humidistat.description: ZoneControlHumidistat. Provide a schedule name to use an existing schedule, or a relative humidity percentage to create a constant schedule.
